name: mnote_links
description: See how one note connects to the rest. Returns `outgoing` (notes this note links to), `backlinks` (notes that link TO it), and `broken` (its `[[targets]]` that don't exist yet) — each resolved entry giving `slug`, `title`, `updated_at`, and the `alias` the link was written with. Use this to TRAVERSE instead of re-listing: when you need context around a note, follow its links and read the neighbours with mnote_get_note. Backlinks are the useful direction — they show what already refers to this topic, which mnote_list_notes cannot tell you. A `broken` target is a note the user (or you) intended but never wrote; creating it with mnote_create_note using that exact `slug` makes every existing link to it resolve at once.
